bullets.title: NVDA: MS reinstates as Top Pick, $300 PT; Feynman to drive $60B+ revenue/GW
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley reinstated NVDA as Top Pick (OW, $300 PT, ~20x CY27 EPS) following constructive NDR. Vera Rubin early-stage; Feynman (2028) expected to lift revenue per GW from $40B to >$50B. Agentic AI drives 10x incremental inference tokens; customer base ~50% ACIE segment (neoclouds, sovereigns, enterprise). Hedgeye remains long NVDA; stock at ~15x FY28 is 'undemanding.' $150B additional buyback authorization ($235B total through FY28) also announced. Bear case $160, bull case $350.

bullets.title: MU: Massive beat & raise; supply tight through CY28; 100% FCF return starting Dec
bullets.body: Micron FQ4 revenue $54.23B (+5.7% vs consensus $51.3B), EPS $33.42 vs $31.72; FQ1 guided $61.5B revenue and $38.15 EPS, both ~7% above Street. Management expects CY27/28 memory supply-demand tighter than CY26; >75% of CY27 output already committed via 26 strategic customer agreements. HBM4 pricing to rise materially in CY27; NV-HBM partnership on custom HBM4E is first memory-system co-design. Buybacks begin Dec 9 (post-CHIPS Act), targeting 100% excess cash return. Multiple analysts raised PTs: Raymond James $1,500, Wolfe $1,500, UBS $1,625, KeyBanc $1,750.

bullets.title: ACN: Massive FQ4 beat; FY27 guide +3-6% cc; bookings inflect to +5% y/y
bullets.body: Accenture FQ4 revenue $18.68B beat guidance high-end of $18.4B, +7% cc; EPS $3.29 vs $3.18 est. FY27 EPS guided $14.39-14.81 (+3-6% cc rev growth), above prior Street of +1-4%. Bookings $22.2B with inflection from -3% y/y in FQ3 to +5% y/y. Stock rallied ~17-18% on print. AI partnerships bookings surged 3x; 400+ new AI client engagements in FY26. Multiple analysts raised PTs: RBC $240, Stifel $242, Citi PT to $220. UBS upgraded to Buy.

bullets.title: AVGO: NDR bullish on F2027/F2028 AI revenue; $42B Anthropic financing announced
bullets.body: UBS reiterates AVGO Buy ($470 PT) after CEO/CFO NDR; F2027 AI revenue to 'at least double' YoY, F2028 to 'at least double again,' guidance viewed as conservative. AVGO confirms 4-5 GW/yr TPU shipments in CY27 with XPU scaling from 4 to 8 and 16 dies. Separately, AVGO has agreed to lend Anthropic up to $42B for infrastructure purchases (convertible debt). AVGO also assembling $60B total financing package. MediaTek delays Google TPU v8 to 2Q27 (samples), cancels Broadcom v9 collab — net positive read for AVGO/MRVL share.

bullets.title: HPE: Daiwa upgrades to Outperform, $75 PT; Networking Day raises FY27 growth to high-teens
bullets.body: Daiwa upgraded HPE from Neutral to Outperform, raising PT to $75 from $65 (9% upside). At the Networking Investor Day, HPE raised FY27 Networking revenue growth guidance to high-teens-to-low-20% (from +14-17%) and raised Juniper synergy target to $800M by FY28 from $600M. Data Center Networking growing at low-to-high 50s% CAGR through FY29. $1.2B AMD Helios rack order from Vultr validates Helios platform. Morgan Stanley raised PT to $72 citing EPS 11-13% above Street; HPE hit 52-week high up +174% YTD.

bullets.title: STX/WDC: Toshiba HDD capacity doubling spooks market; Citi and MS say 'buy the dip'
bullets.body: Toshiba announced ¥60B ($380M) Philippines factory expansion to ~double HDD production by FY27, targeting 30% market share from 10%. STX fell ~11% and WDC ~7-13% on the day with 249% and 515% above-average options volume (WDC/VIAV). Citi maintains bullish STX ($1,300 PT) and WDC ($740 PT) at 23x FY28 EPS, arguing Toshiba lacks internal media/heads sourcing, lags on density (30-34TB vs 40TB for STX/WDC by 2027), and supply-demand gap remains >300 EB through CY28. Morgan Stanley also says 'buy dip' as HDD capacity sold through CY28.

bullets.title: LITE/COHR: Rally 8-11% on likely FCC optical transceiver restrictions targeting China at 3.2T
bullets.body: LITE +7.7%, COHR +10.9%, FN +6.4% on reports that FCC is likely to restrict China-based optical transceivers at the 3.2T generation (~2028 ramp). Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan detail that a 65% US-content BOM workaround would keep module vendors viable while benefiting US laser vendors LITE/COHR most. Jefferies forecasts AI transceiver demand of 180M units in CY27, 245M in CY28. The FCC rule would shape next-gen supply chain rather than displace current Chinese supply immediately.

bullets.title: META: Enterprise Platform launches with Muse; hires MongoDB CEO; agentic AI dominant theme
bullets.body: META launched Meta Enterprise Platform (Muse agent, Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code) for businesses; simultaneously hired MongoDB CEO CJ Desai as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer. Muse reached 3M weekly active users in <1 month. Morgan Stanley names META Top Pick in Internet with bullish Muse TAM (~$30T agentic). Hedgeye long META as one of two 'alpha dogs' alongside MSFT. Citi's agentic AI basket (MSXXCLAW) +22% since Muse launch while at-risk basket (MSXXARSK) -9%.

bullets.title: MDB: CEO Desai departs for META; Dev Ittycheria returns as interim CEO; -18-22% on day
bullets.body: MongoDB CEO CJ Desai departed effective immediately (<1 year in role) to become META's Chief Enterprise Platform Officer. Dev Ittycheria (CEO 2014-2025, scaled revenue $35M→$2.3B) returns as interim CEO. Q3/FY27 guidance reaffirmed; Investor Day proceeded as scheduled. Stock fell 18-22%. Wolfe maintains Outperform $500 PT calling it opportunity-driven departure, not fundamental signal; notes comparable deals at 8x FY+2 sales vs MDB's ~7x CY27. DA Davidson and Hedgeye also constructive at current levels. MDB raised FY27 guidance at Investor Day: LT rev growth high-teens, Atlas to mid-20%.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Gemini 4 Argon launches; Citi/JPM reiterate Buy; TPU monetization could add $100B EBIT
bullets.body: Google released Gemini 4 Argon, ranking top in 14 of 19 benchmarks vs GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1. Pricing aggressive: $2/$10 per 1M input/output tokens intro (vs $10/$50 for Claude Fable 5.1). Citi reiterates Buy, $447 PT, saying Argon 'removes key overhang.' JPM raises PT to $420 Dec-27; models TPU sales to Anthropic at 1 GW (2026), 5 GW (2027), 10 GW (2028) generating ~$100B EBIT vs $270B total 2028 EBIT estimate. MediaTek delay on TPU v8/v9 could shift Google back to Marvell (positive MRVL read).

bullets.title: MSFT: Copilot Super App exceeds 30M paid subs; JPM OW $625 PT; Cloud ROIC stable at 32-33%
bullets.body: Microsoft Copilot Super App surpassed 30M paid subscribers (faster adoption than prior MSFT products). Copilot repositioned as primary AI OS with Home, Code, and Autopilot (persistent proactive agent). JPM reiterates OW, $625 PT, detailing Microsoft Cloud ROIC stabilizing at 32-33% FY27-31E (down from ~54% FY24 but still above cost of capital). Hedgeye calls MSFT one of two 'alpha dogs' in Mag7 alongside META. Piper raised PT to $610 on M365 consumption revenue path to $2B run-rate by FY28.

bullets.title: AMZN: Goldman adds to Conviction List; $8B NVDA chip SPV offloading; AWS AI growth
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs added AMZN to its US Conviction List for October citing accelerating AI/AWS, advertising, and eCommerce profitability. Separately, Reuters reported Amazon is seeking to offload ~$8B of NVDA chips to investors via a new SPV (leasing chips back), aimed at strengthening the balance sheet. AWS raised NVDA chip service prices. EU regulators finalizing DMA gatekeeper designation for Azure and AWS, expected as early as November with potential fines up to 10% of global turnover.

bullets.title: DKNG: Short Bias at Hedgeye; prediction market spend exceeds guidance; FLUT moves to Long
bullets.body: Hedgeye maintains Short Bias on DKNG into Q4 2027 with the most challenging setup in online gaming. DKNG is pulling forward prediction market investment from FY27 into FY26, with total spend likely to exceed prior $200-300M guidance; FY26 adj. EBITDA likely below $700-900M guidance range. DKNG's DKeX grew 22x MoM in September to ~$2B in contracts, reaching 2.8% market share. JPMorgan maintains Overweight on DKNG citing strong NFL handle (+15% YoY) and attractive long-term LTV/CAC on prediction markets. FLUT upgraded to Long Bias by Hedgeye.

bullets.title: MRVL: Investor Day Oct 6; expects $40B+ 2030 revenue with 40%+ AI capex CAGR
bullets.body: Ahead of the Oct 6 Investor Day, Citi and Piper previews expect MRVL to materially raise 2028 market share targets and 2030 EPS guidance ($15-20 range) with 100-200bps operating margin expansion. Piper flags XPU Attach opportunity as underestimated; $120B Google TPU deal as proxy for hyperscaler datacenter wins. MRVL raised FY27/FY28 guidance to ~$12B/$18B. Google may shift TPU v9 from MediaTek to MRVL following MTK tape-out delays. Citi PT $275 (28x CY28E EPS).

bullets.title: SHOP: Morgan Stanley 'agnostic agentic winner'; payment economics upside from money transmitter licenses
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley calls SHOP the primary beneficiary of agentic eCommerce given its transaction-based monetization model and ~70% Payments GPV penetration. SHOP launched Canvas AI store-builder tool and is integrated into META Muse and OpenAI agent shopping flows. Separately, SHOP is pursuing nationwide money transmitter licenses that could add 2% GP and 5% EBIT uplift by 2028 (Mizuho). SHOP +3% in Canada mid-morning. UBS notes Neutral but highlights new 1.25% premium fee for third-party processor users as incremental revenue.

bullets.title: CCL: Strong 3Q beat; FY yields raised to +2.3%; 2027 booked at record occupancy/pricing
bullets.body: Carnival 3Q Adj. EPS $1.43 beat guide $1.35; EBITDA $2.99B beat $2.88B guided. FY26 net yield raised 55bps to +2.3% (Street was +1.8%); FY26 EPS raised to $2.24. 4Q guided +1.7% yield vs prior implied +1.0%. 2027 already ~50% booked at record occupancy and pricing; 2028 also ahead. Customer deposits Q3 record $7.6B. $1.2B share repurchases YTD. S&P upgrade to investment grade during the quarter. UBS Buy $36 PT; Citi Buy $37 PT; GS raises PT to $32.

bullets.title: NFLX: Upgraded to Buy at Deutsche Bank ($95 PT); co-CEO acknowledges slower-than-desired growth
bullets.body: Deutsche Bank upgraded NFLX to Buy from Hold, cutting PT to $95 from $100 on valuation. Co-CEO Ted Sarandos publicly acknowledged 'not growing as fast as I want.' Live programming represents ~5% of $20B content budget; company planning wider theatrical releases for major films. NFLX media sector positioning: sold off -2% on broader sector fund flows/rotation around rate moves; Hedgeye has NFLX as bearish TREND signal (range 65-72 bearish).

bullets.title: PSKY/WBD: Merger closing Oct 6; ticker changing to SKYD; $6B synergies but 4x+ net debt
bullets.body: Paramount Skydance received judicial approval to close its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on October 6, 2026. Ticker changes from PSKY to SKYD effective Oct 6 when Class B shares list on NYSE. Combined entity projected at $28B content spend, $65B revenues, $11B+ EBITDA pre-synergies; $6B in synergies seen achievable but net leverage will exceed 4x at peak rates. Ynon Kreiz (Mattel CEO departing) joins combined company in senior leadership role. WBD De Luca and Abdy exiting.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone Duo yield issues (~60% at launch); Vision Pro pushed to 2028-29; smart home Oct 13
bullets.body: Apple iPhone Duo assembly yields ~60% in mid-September, expected to take 6-12 months to normalize, limiting supply. Vision Pro lacking product-market fit, pushed to late 2028/early 2029, team on 'life support.' Apple plans Oct 13 smart home launch: J490 hub, HomePod mini update, new TV set-top box. AAPL MS valuation 'full' at 35x CY27 EPS; Woodring awaiting better re-entry. Hedgeye bullish AAPL as core large-cap position alongside META/MSFT/NVDA. Apple hit with $5.7B haptic patent damages order.

bullets.title: HOOD: Upgraded to Overweight at Morgan Stanley ($150 PT) and KeyBanc ($140 PT) on agentic trading
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley upgraded HOOD to Overweight with $150 PT citing broader platform deepening wallet share and more durable growth. KeyBanc raised PT to $140 maintaining Overweight after HOOD Summit unveiled ~15 platform updates: native AI agents, earnings prediction contracts, perpetual futures (Bitstamp, 8 crypto assets), and 24/7 equities with 4x intraday margin. Goldman raised PT to $145 on stronger September volumes (crypto +21% MoM, prediction markets +17% MoM). Wells Fargo initiated equal weight at $125.
